Animate a goal as an MP4

Source: R/animate.R
animate_goal.Rd

Writes a goal's tracking replay as a video: every skater, both goalies and the puck on the rink, positions eased between the ten-a-second tracking frames, each player's sweater number in his club's colors, the puck's trail, the scorer ringed with his skating speed above him, the moment it went in, and then the last three seconds again at half speed. The rink is in feet from centre ice, as everywhere in bluelineR.

Usage

animate_goal(
  frames,
  file = "goal.mp4",
  goal = NULL,
  team = NULL,
  fps = 30,
  slow_motion = TRUE,
  width = 1280,
  height = 720,
  title = NULL,
  logos = FALSE,
  centre_logo = NULL
)

Arguments

frames

Tracking frames from nhl_goal_tracking() or read_goal_tracking().

file

Where to write the video (.mp4; .gif and .webm work too).

goal

Optional: the goal from nhl_goal_replay().

team

The scoring club, when goal is not given and it cannot be worked out from the frames (empty-net goals).

fps

Frames per second.

slow_motion

Replay the three seconds before the goal at half speed.

width, height

Size in pixels.

title

Title; NULL for the scorer, period and clock when goal is given.

logos

Draw the clubs' logos (from goal, which has their addresses). Needs the rsvg package.

centre_logo

The URL or path of a logo for centre ice, in place of the home club's: an SVG (needs rsvg) or a PNG (needs png).

Value

file, invisibly.

Details

Pass the goal from nhl_goal_replay() as goal to name the scorer and his assists on the ice and title the video; without it the scorer is the shooter classify_goal() finds and nobody is named.

With logos = TRUE the clubs' logos stand in for their abbreviations in the title and the home club's logo goes on centre ice; centre_logo puts another there, like a special event's.

Frames are drawn with base graphics and encoded by the av package (H.264 where FFmpeg has it); a full-size clip takes under a minute.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive() && requireNamespace("av", quietly = TRUE)
frames <- nhl_goal_tracking(2025020534, 777)
animate_goal(frames, "mcdavid.mp4", goal = nhl_goal_replay(2025020534, 777))

# McDavid's overtime winner in the 4 Nations final, with the logos:
four_nations <- paste0("https://assets.nhle.com/special_event_season/20242025/svg/",
                       "4n-2025-championship-extwm-en_light.svg")
animate_goal(nhl_goal_tracking(2024200007, 1443), "4-nations.mp4",
             goal = nhl_goal_replay(2024200007, 1443), logos = TRUE, centre_logo = four_nations)

# Offline, from the copy that ships with the package:
path <- system.file("extdata", "goal-2025020534-777.json.gz", package = "bluelineR")
animate_goal(read_goal_tracking(path, 2025020534, 777), tempfile(fileext = ".mp4"), team = "EDM")
}
